_comment: Machine-readable manifest for base composition #1. Generated 2026-05-15 from `drive/Описание лонгрида - порядок базовых слоев.csv` (rows where id_layer_base=1) and the QML files now co-located in this folder. This file is the runtime source of truth — `src/layerStyles.ts` and `src/baseCompositions.ts` import it. Placeholders are flagged with `placeholder: true`.

render_order.name: relief_hillshade
render_order.note: Pre-baked pixel multiply of relief × hillshade. Replaces the two separate raster rows of the CSV (relief multiply + hillshade multiply). Deployed at https://pashteto.github.io/gavr-tiles/relief_hillshade/{z}/{x}/{y}.png and amphitheater.pashteto.com/tiles/relief_hillshade/{z}/{x}/{y}.png.

render_order.name: sectors_level
render_order.note: Faithful to sectors_level.qml <renderer-v2>: singleSymbol SimpleFill with transparent fill (255,210,236 @ alpha 0) and a black DASHED outline at 0.1 mm. We render no fill + a black dashed line (width bumped 0.1 mm→1.0 px for legibility). The earlier orange fill/outline/line was mis-ported from the QML's <elevation> profile symbols.

render_order.name: isoline_5m
render_order.note: Source GeoJSON is 181 MB — bundled copy is simplified to 25 m tolerance in EPSG:3857 (3.5 MB, 1843 features). Regenerate via base-layer-1-prep/.

render_order.name: stage
render_order.note: Faithful to stage.qml <renderer-v2>: a LinePatternFill (symbol alpha 0.579) with teal hatch lines rgb(50,126,105) @ ~0.6 alpha over a white wash rgb(255,255,255) @ ~0.6 alpha, 45°, distance 1.6 mm (~4.5 px), line width 0.46 mm (~1.3 px); outline #232323. Combined opacity ≈ 0.6 × 0.579 ≈ 0.34. The earlier magenta fill + white hatch + pink line/outline was mis-ported from the QML's <elevation> profile symbols.

render_order.name: water
render_order.note: Faithful to water.qml <renderer-v2>: singleSymbol SimpleFill, light-blue rgb(194,210,242), with an invisible outline (35,35,35 @ alpha 0) — so no outline/line. QML alpha is opaque; opacity dialed to 0.45 so relief reads through. The earlier red fill/outline/line was mis-ported from the QML's <elevation> profile symbols.

render_order.name: positron_labels
render_order.note: Subtle city/town labels overlay sourced from CartoCDN's `light_only_labels` style. Sits at the top of the base stack (above relief + vectors, below per-section overlays via the OVERLAY_ANCHOR_ID). Free tier; monitor traffic and switch to self-hosted (tilemaker over OSM) if usage grows past ~10k tiles/day. See plan/07-positron-labels.md.

calibration_note: QML widths are in millimeters; MapLibre line-width is in screen pixels. Outline widths bumped from QML's 0.2 mm (≈0.57 px, invisible at typical zoom) to 1.0 px for legibility. Calibrate visually on the dev build at z=12 and adjust if lines read too thin or too heavy.
